meals.recipe_name: Protein Banana Oatmeal with Peanut Butter
recipe_steps: 1. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine 1 cup rolled oats and 1.5 cups whole milk.
2. Stir constantly and bring to a gentle simmer, about 4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low.
3. Cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes until oats are creamy and thickened.
4. Remove from heat and let cool 1 minute (to avoid clumping protein). Stir in 1 scoop vanilla whey protein powder until fully dissolved.
5. Slice 1 banana. Transfer oatmeal to a bowl, top with banana slices, 2 tbsp peanut butter, drizzle 1 tbsp honey, and dust with 0.5 tsp cinnamon.
6. Stir slightly and serve warm.

meals.recipe_name: Grilled Chicken Burrito Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Pat 8 oz chicken breast dry. Rub with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 0.5 tsp salt, and 0.5 tbsp olive oil.
2. Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat with 0.5 tbsp olive oil until shimmering.
3. Cook chicken 6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
4. Warm 1 cup cooked white rice and 0.75 cup black beans in the microwave 90 seconds.
5. Add 0.5 cup corn to the hot skillet for 2 minutes to char lightly.
6. Build bowl: rice base, then beans, corn, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced avocado, and chicken.
7. Squeeze juice of 1 lime over the top and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move one 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to a plate in the fridge Sunday night for Monday lunch. If forgotten, cold-water thaw Monday morning: seal in a zip bag, submerge in cold water ~40 min, changing water every 30 min.

Cook a pot of white rice: rinse 2 cups dry rice, combine with 3 cups water, bring to boil, cover, simmer 18 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate portioned; this base covers multiple meals this week (use within 3-4 days).

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Garlic Butter Rice and Broccoli
recipe_steps: 1. Pat 7 oz salmon dry, season both sides with 0.5 tsp salt and 0.25 tsp black pepper.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high until shimmering.
3. Place salmon skin-side down, press gently, and sear 4 minutes until skin is crisp.
4. Flip and cook 3 more minutes until internal temp reaches 125-130°F. Remove and rest.
5. Steam 1.5 cups broccoli in a covered pot with 2 tbsp water over medium heat for 4 minutes until bright green.
6. In the same salmon skillet, lower heat to medium, add 2 tbsp butter and 3 minced garlic cloves. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
7. Add 1 cup cooked rice, toss to coat in garlic butter for 2 minutes.
8. Plate rice and broccoli, top with salmon, and squeeze juice of 0.5 lemon over everything.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move one 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner. Alternatively cold-water thaw Monday afternoon (~30 min, sealed, changing water every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with 0.75 cup mixed berries and 0.33 cup granola.
3. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top and serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Almond Chocolate Protein Shake
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1.5 cups whole milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1 banana, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
2. Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth and frothy.
3. Pour into a glass and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Three-Egg Veggie Scramble with Cheddar Toast
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk 3 whole eggs and 3 egg whites with 0.25 tsp salt in a bowl.
2. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium. Add 0.5 diced bell pepper, cook 3 minutes.
3. Add 1 cup spinach, cook 1 minute until wilted.
4. Pour in eggs, let set 20 seconds, then gently fold with a spatula for 2-3 minutes until just set.
5. Sprinkle 1 oz shredded cheddar over eggs, fold once, remove from heat.
6. Toast 2 slices homemade bread, spread with 1 tbsp butter. Serve alongside scramble.

prep_tasks.instructions: Make one loaf: mix 3.5 cups bread flour, 1.25 cups warm water, 2.25 tsp instant yeast, 2 tbsp sugar, 1.5 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil. Knead 10 min, rise 1 hr until doubled, shape into loaf pan, rise 40 min, bake at 375°F for 32 min. Cool fully, slice, store; use slices across the week.

meals.recipe_name: Teriyaki Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water into a sauce. Set aside.
2. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.
3. Add 8 oz beef strips in a single layer, sear 2 minutes without moving, then stir-fry 1 minute. Remove.
4. Add 1 cup broccoli and 0.5 sliced bell pepper, stir-fry 3 minutes.
5. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp grated ginger, cook 30 seconds.
6. Return beef, pour in sauce, toss 1-2 minutes until glossy and thickened.
7. Serve over 1 cup warmed cooked rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz beef sirloin strips from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday lunch. Or cold-water thaw Tuesday morning (~35 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Mashed Sweet Potato
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Peel and cube 2 sweet potatoes, boil in salted water 15 minutes until fork-tender.
2. Pat 8 oz pork tenderloin dry, rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp rosemary, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp pepper.
3. Sear pork in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high 2 minutes per side until browned.
4. Transfer skillet to oven, roast 12-14 minutes until internal temp reaches 145°F. Rest 5 minutes, slice.
5. Drain sweet potatoes, mash with 1 tbsp butter and 0.25 tsp salt.
6. Sauté 1.5 cups green beans in 1 tbsp butter with 2 minced garlic cloves over medium heat 5 minutes.
7. Plate mash, green beans, and sliced pork.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner. Or cold-water thaw Tuesday afternoon (~40 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Walnuts
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
2. Top with 0.75 cup pineapple chunks and 0.25 cup walnuts.
3. Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipe_steps: 1. Combine 1.5 cups whole milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1.5 tbsp peanut butter, 0.25 cup oats, and 1 cup ice in a blender.
2. Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth.
3. Pour and drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Melt on Homemade Bread with Fruit
recipe_steps: 1. Drain 1 can tuna, mix in a bowl with 1 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp Greek yogurt.
2. Butter one side of each of 2 bread slices with 1 tbsp butter total.
3. Place one slice butter-side down in a skillet over medium heat. Top with tuna mix and 1 oz shredded cheddar.
4. Add second slice, butter-side up. Cook 3 minutes until golden, flip, cook 3 more minutes until cheese melts.
5. Slice sandwich in half, serve with 1 sliced apple.

meals.recipe_name: Shrimp Scampi Linguine
recipe_steps: 1. Boil 4 oz linguine in salted water per package directions (~9 min) until al dente. Reserve 0.5 cup pasta water, drain.
2. Pat 8 oz shrimp dry, season with 0.25 tsp salt.
3. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high. Add shrimp, cook 1.5 min per side until pink. Remove.
4. Lower heat to medium, add remaining 1 tbsp butter, 4 minced garlic cloves, 0.25 tsp red pepper flakes. Cook 1 minute.
5. Add juice of 0.5 lemon and 0.25 cup reserved pasta water, simmer 1 minute.
6. Add drained linguine, shrimp, and 2 tbsp parsley. Toss 1 minute to coat.
7. Top with 0.25 cup grated parmesan and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch. Or cold-water thaw Wednesday morning (~20 min, sealed, in cold water).

meals.recipe_name: Ground Turkey Taco Skillet with Rice
recipe_steps: 1. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add 8 oz ground turkey, break apart, cook 6 minutes until browned.
2. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, and 0.25 tsp salt, stir 1 minute.
3. Add 0.5 cup black beans and 0.5 cup corn, cook 3 minutes.
4. Warm 1 cup cooked rice and add to the skillet, tossing 2 minutes.
5. Remove from heat, top with 1 oz shredded cheddar, halved cherry tomatoes, and sliced avocado.
6. Serve directly from the skillet.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner. Or cold-water thaw Wednesday afternoon (~40 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Greek Yogurt Protein Pudding
recipe_steps: 1. In a bowl, whisk 1 cup Greek yogurt with 0.5 scoop chocolate whey, 1 tsp cocoa powder, and 1 tbsp honey until smooth and thick.
2. Top with 2 tbsp chopped walnuts and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Banana and Almonds
recipe_steps: 1. Place 3 eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil.
2. Once boiling, cover, remove from heat, let sit 11 minutes.
3. Transfer eggs to an ice bath 5 minutes, then peel.
4. Serve eggs with 1 banana and 0.25 cup almonds.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
recipe_steps: 1. Blend 0.75 cup oats, 2 eggs, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 banana, and 1 tsp baking powder into a smooth batter.
2. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
3. Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter, cook 2 minutes until bubbles form, flip, cook 1.5 minutes more. Repeat for ~4 pancakes.
4. Stack pancakes, top with 0.5 cup Greek yogurt, 0.5 cup berries, and 1 tbsp maple syrup.

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Caesar Wrap with Homemade Tortilla
recipe_steps: 1. Make tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 0.5 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 3 min, rest 20 min.
2. Divide into 2 balls, roll each thin. Cook in a dry skillet over medium-high 60 seconds per side until puffed and spotted. Set aside.
3. Season 7 oz chicken breast with 0.25 tsp salt. Cook in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high 6 min per side to 165°F. Rest, slice.
4. Toss 2 cups chopped romaine with 2 tbsp caesar dressing and 0.25 cup parmesan.
5. Fill tortillas with salad and sliced chicken, roll tightly, and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch. Or cold-water thaw Thursday morning (~40 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

Optional time-saver: mix the tortilla dough Wednesday night (1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp oil, 0.5 cup warm water), wrap tightly, refrigerate. Pull out 20 min before rolling Thursday.

meals.recipe_name: Bison Burgers with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut 2 sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 tsp paprika, 0.25 tsp salt. Roast 25 min, flipping halfway.
2. Form 8 oz ground bison into 1 patty, season both sides with 0.5 tsp salt.
3. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook patty 4 min per side to 155°F.
4. Top patty with 1 oz cheddar in the last minute to melt.
5. Toast 1 homemade bun. Assemble with lettuce, 2 tomato slices, and the patty.
6. Serve burger with sweet potato wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday dinner. Or cold-water thaw Thursday afternoon (~40 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

Make-and-freeze: mix 3 cups bread flour, 1 cup warm milk, 1 egg, 3 tbsp sugar, 2.25 tsp yeast, 3 tbsp butter, 1 tsp salt. Knead 8 min, rise 1 hr, shape 8 buns, bake at 375°F for 15 min Tuesday. Cool, freeze in a bag. Thaw one bun at room temp Thursday morning (~1 hr).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Toast with Honey and Berries
recipe_steps: 1. Toast 2 slices homemade bread until golden.
2. Spread 0.75 cup cottage cheese evenly over both slices.
3. Top with 0.5 cup berries and drizzle 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Banana Protein Smoothie
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 1 banana, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 0.25 cup oats, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
2. Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth. Drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Smoked Salmon and Egg Bagel Stack
recipe_steps: 1. Slice and toast 1 homemade bagel.
2. Scramble 2 eggs in 1 tsp butter over medium heat, folding gently 2 minutes until just set.
3. Spread 2 tbsp cream cheese on both bagel halves.
4. Layer 3 oz smoked salmon, scrambled eggs, 2 red onion slices, and 1 tbsp capers.
5. Close bagel and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Make-and-freeze: mix 4 cups bread flour, 1.5 cups warm water, 2.25 tsp yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp salt. Knead 10 min, rise 1 hr, shape 8 bagels, boil each 60 sec, bake at 425°F for 20 min Tuesday. Cool, freeze. Thaw one bagel at room temp Friday morning (~45 min) before toasting.

meals.recipe_name: Korean Beef Bibimbap
recipe_steps: 1. Toss 7 oz beef strips with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 0.5 tbsp sesame oil.
2. Julienne 1 carrot. Sauté in 0.5 tsp sesame oil over medium 3 min, remove.
3. Wilt 1 cup spinach in the pan 1 minute, remove.
4. Raise heat to high, sear the beef 3 minutes until caramelized. Remove.
5. Fry 1 egg sunny-side up in the same pan, 2 minutes.
6. Plate 1 cup warm rice, arrange beef, carrot, and spinach in sections, top with the fried egg.
7. Add 1 tbsp gochujang, drizzle 0.5 tbsp sesame oil, sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds. Mix before eating.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz beef sirloin strips from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday lunch. Or cold-water thaw Friday morning (~35 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Blackened Shrimp Tacos with Homemade Tortillas
recipe_steps: 1. Make tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.5 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 3 min, rest 20 min. Divide into 3, roll thin, cook in a dry skillet 60 sec per side. Keep warm.
2. Mix 0.25 cup Greek yogurt with juice of 0.5 lime and pinch of salt for crema.
3. Pat 8 oz shrimp dry, toss with 1 tsp paprika, 0.5 tsp cumin, 0.25 tsp cayenne, 0.25 tsp salt.
4. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high, cook shrimp 1.5 min per side until blackened and opaque.
5. Shred 1 cup cabbage, slice 0.5 avocado.
6. Fill tortillas with shrimp, cabbage, avocado, and crema. Squeeze remaining lime and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz shrimp from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday dinner. Or cold-water thaw Friday afternoon (~20 min, sealed, cold water).

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Granola and Honey
recipe_steps: 1. Layer half the yogurt in a glass, then half the granola and berries.
2. Repeat layers with remaining yogurt, granola, and berries.
3. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey on top and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Almond Protein Shake with Oats
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1.5 tbsp almond butter, 0.25 cup oats, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
2. Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth. Drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Home Fries
recipe_steps: 1. Dice 1 potato and 0.5 bell pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high, add potato, cook 10 min stirring occasionally.
2. Add bell pepper, 0.5 tsp paprika, 0.25 tsp salt, cook 4 more min until crisp. Remove.
3. Season 6 oz sirloin with 0.5 tsp salt. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over high heat 3 min per side to 130°F. Rest 5 min, slice.
4. Fry 3 eggs in 1 tbsp butter over medium, 3 minutes for runny yolks.
5. Plate steak, eggs, and home fries together.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz beef sirloin from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday breakfast. Or cold-water thaw Saturday morning (~30 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Seared Tuna Poke Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 0.5 tbsp sesame oil, and 1 tbsp rice vinegar for the sauce.
2. Pat 7 oz tuna dry. Heat 0.5 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over high heat until smoking.
3. Sear tuna 1 minute per side for a rare center. Rest 2 min, slice thin.
4. Slice 0.5 cucumber, julienne 0.5 carrot, slice 0.5 avocado.
5. Build bowl: 1 cup warm rice, then cucumber, carrot, avocado, and sliced tuna.
6. Drizzle sauce, sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds and sliced green onion. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ahi tuna steak from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday lunch. Or cold-water thaw Saturday morning (~30 min, sealed, cold water).

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Parmesan over Linguine
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Boil 4 oz linguine until al dente (~9 min), drain, toss with a splash of marinara.
2. Butterfly 8 oz chicken breast, season with 0.5 tsp salt. Set up 3 bowls: 0.25 cup flour, 1 beaten egg, 0.5 cup breadcrumbs mixed with 2 tbsp parmesan.
3. Dredge chicken in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs.
4. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Fry chicken 3 min per side until golden.
5. Top chicken with 1 cup marinara, 2 oz mozzarella, and remaining parmesan.
6. Bake 10 minutes until cheese is bubbly and chicken reaches 165°F.
7. Serve over linguine.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner. Or cold-water thaw Saturday afternoon (~45 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches and Almonds
recipe_steps: 1. Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
2. Slice 1 peach and add on top with 2 tbsp almonds.
3. Drizzle 1 tsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1 cup milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 1 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
2. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Drink immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Loaded Breakfast Burrito with Homemade Tortilla
recipe_steps: 1. Make 1 large tortilla: mix 0.75 cup flour, 0.25 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil, 0.3 cup warm water. Knead 3 min, rest 15 min, roll thin, cook in dry skillet 60 sec per side.
2. Brown 4 oz ground turkey with 0.5 tsp cumin and 0.25 tsp salt in 0.5 tbsp oil over medium-high 5 min. Remove.
3. Sauté 0.5 diced bell pepper 2 min. Add 3 beaten eggs, scramble 2 min until set.
4. Lay tortilla flat, fill with turkey, eggs, peppers, 1 oz cheddar, and 0.5 sliced avocado.
5. Fold in sides and roll tightly. Sear seam-side down in the skillet 1 min. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 4 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday breakfast. Or cold-water thaw Sunday morning (~25 min, sealed, cold water).

meals.recipe_name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon with Jasmine Rice and Bok Choy
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 3 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tbsp rice vinegar for glaze.
2. Heat 0.5 tbsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear 7 oz salmon skin-side down 4 min, flip, cook 2 min.
3. Pour glaze over salmon, spoon over the fish, and simmer 2 min until sticky and internal temp reaches 130°F. Remove.
4. In the same pan, add 0.5 tbsp sesame oil and 2 cups halved bok choy, stir-fry 3 min until tender-crisp.
5. Plate 1 cup warm rice, bok choy, and glazed salmon. Sprinkle 1 tsp sesame seeds. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch. Or cold-water thaw Sunday morning (~30 min, sealed, cold water).

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Herb Roast Chicken Thighs with Potatoes and Asparagus
recipe_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Halve 8 oz baby potatoes, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 0.25 tsp salt. Spread on a sheet pan, roast 15 min.
2. Pat 10 oz chicken thighs dry, rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp rosemary, 0.5 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp pepper, 4 minced garlic cloves.
3. Sear thighs skin-side down in a hot skillet 4 min until crisp.
4. Add thighs to the sheet pan with potatoes, roast 15 min.
5. Add trimmed asparagus to the pan, roast 8 more min until chicken reaches 175°F.
6. Finish with 1 tbsp butter melted over asparagus and juice of 0.5 lemon. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz bone-in chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner. Or cold-water thaw Sunday afternoon (~50 min, sealed, water changed every 30 min).

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Protein Bark Bowl
recipe_steps: 1. Whisk 1 cup Greek yogurt with 0.5 scoop vanilla whey until smooth.
2. Top with 0.5 cup berries, 2 tbsp almonds, and drizzle 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Banana Oat Protein Shake
recipe_steps: 1. Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 banana, 0.25 cup oats, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
2. Blend 45 seconds until smooth. Drink immediately.
